hypothesis: Medusa's default locking provider is InMemoryLockingProvider, whose lock map lives in each process. The reservation path (reserveInventoryStep / ensureInventoryLevels with validateQuantityAtLocation) relies on locks to serialize stock checks, but with two servers sharing one database, each server holds its own lock map, so two carts for the single SOLO unit completed on different servers at the same moment can both pass the availability check and both create reservations, overselling SOLO (stock 1). I expect no_oversell to fail in some runs, and possibly reserved_matches_reservations if the counters drift.
